themes.name: Semiconductors
themes.scope: Semiconductor design, foundry manufacturing, memory, and fabrication equipment.
excluded: General software and electronics customers without an established semiconductor business
themes.anchor_rationale: VanEck describes SMH as tracking the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index and its index semiconductor-revenue screen. That is a direct mandate match to this registry scope. The fund is concentrated, so top weights are shown; anchor choice is not switched based on recent return.
themes.representation_limit: SMH may hold non-US issuers and ADRs. The stock subset is limited to verified NYSE/Nasdaq listings; any ADR mapping is labeled.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.

themes.name: Cybersecurity
themes.scope: Companies whose established products directly protect networks, endpoints, identities, applications, or enterprise data.
excluded: Generic technology adoption, customer association, pilots, and incidental security features
themes.anchor_rationale: First Trust's Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity ETF has an explicit cybersecurity mandate, current holdings, and published index materials. Cybersecurity spans several industries, so no single parent-sector ETF is assigned.
themes.representation_limit: The fund includes non-US securities and companies with adjacent technology businesses. Each issuer still needs independent business evidence.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.

themes.name: Clean Energy
themes.scope: Renewable electricity generation and established equipment or services directly used to generate or manage renewable power.
included: Established renewable generation equipment and power-control systems
excluded: General utilities without material renewable exposure
EVs, batteries, and broad electrification without a directly matching established activity
themes.anchor_rationale: The iShares Global Clean Energy ETF tracks a global clean-energy mandate and its dated holdings are downloadable. QCLN is a U.S.-tilted alternative with broader clean-technology exposure; ICLN better fits this narrower renewable-generation scope. The comparison is about mandate fit, not recent return.
themes.representation_limit: ICLN is global. The formal stock universe contains only verified eligible U.S.-listed securities, so it is a U.S.-listed subset of the fund.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.

themes.name: Aerospace & Defense
themes.scope: U.S.-listed companies with established aerospace manufacturing, defense systems, or mission-critical components as a core business.
included: Commercial and military aerospace equipment and components
excluded: General industrial companies without a material aerospace or defense business
themes.anchor_rationale: XAR follows the S&P Aerospace & Defense Select Industry Index and uses a more even holding-weight profile than ITA. In the retrieved 2026-10-21 snapshots, XAR's top five weights sum to about 16%, while ITA's top five sum to about 55%; XAR is selected for broader constituent representation. Both are accessible and have sufficient history.
themes.representation_limit: XAR holdings can include component suppliers and non-defense aerospace businesses; each company is reviewed against the stated scope.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.

themes.name: Cloud Computing
themes.scope: Public cloud infrastructure, cloud platforms, and established software services primarily delivered through cloud deployment.
included: Cloud-native platforms and established SaaS businesses
excluded: Companies that merely use cloud services
Hardware suppliers without a direct established cloud business
themes.anchor_rationale: First Trust's ISE Cloud Computing ETF has an explicit cloud-computing mandate and a current dated holdings table. Its holdings include platform, infrastructure, and software companies; only issuers with a direct established cloud business pass the separate evidence review.
themes.representation_limit: The index's cloud categories are broader than this watchlist's business-evidence rule. Unreviewed holdings are shown separately and excluded from formal selection.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.

themes.name: Biotechnology
excluded: Biotechnology-classified stocks, per the default stock-universe rule
themes.anchor_rationale: XBI tracks the S&P Biotechnology Select Industry Index and provides a valid ETF-level comparison. The specification excludes companies classified as biotechnology from the stock universe, so holdings are not promoted into stock candidates; no empty stock universe is claimed without screening.
themes.representation_limit: Stock selection is intentionally withheld until issuer-level industry screening is complete; the biotechnology exclusion applies to stocks, not the ETF's own returns.
themes.anchor_instrument_review: Plain-vanilla long-only USD equity ETF; official fund mandate checked for inverse or leveraged objective.
